P33E200.title: EQS/EQE HV Battery Chiller Coolant Circuit Pressure Loss & Pump Replacement
P33E200.repair_steps: 1. Perform XENTRY guided high-voltage intrinsic safety isolation. 2. Pressure-test low-temp chiller loop at 1.4 bar for 15 min. 3. Replace auxiliary electric coolant pump (A2935002000) and vacuum-bleed circuit with MB Coolant 325.6 (A0009899302).

C156F01.title: W206 AIRMATIC Front Axle Lowering & Compressor Thermal Protection Fault
C156F01.repair_steps: 1. Confirm micro-fissure in front right elastomer air bellow using leak-detector spray. 2. Replace front right AIRMATIC strut assembly (A2063201400) and preventive-replace compressor solid-state relay (A0993200158). 3. Run XENTRY pneumatic level calibration.

P0A9400.title: W223 S-Class 48V ISG DC/DC Converter Voltage Regulation Fault
P0A9400.repair_steps: 1. De-energize 48V on-board network via XENTRY. 2. Replace 48V/12V DC/DC converter control unit (A2569068800) and 48V bus Hall-effect current sensor (A0009052211). 3. Flash N129/1 software and clear fault memory.

P1C8A00.title: AMG E Performance Rear EDU 2-Speed Shift Actuator Hydraulic Pressure Fault
P1C8A00.repair_steps: 1. Drain Rear Axle Electric Drive Unit (N145) gear oil. 2. Replace Rear EDU hydraulic shift actuator manifold (A2902701500), refill with AMG Hypoid Gear Oil (A0029890403), and run XENTRY dog-clutch kiss-point adaptation.

C118B29.title: EQE/EQS Rear-Axle Steering (RAS) Rotor Position Sensor Signal Fault
C118B29.repair_steps: 1. Lock rear steering rack in centered service position. 2. Replace complete 10-degree Rear-Axle Steering spindle actuator assembly (A2974601800). 3. Perform 4-wheel optical alignment and execute zero-angle sensor calibration in N68/4.

U111300.title: MBUX NTG7 Wireless Apple CarPlay Connectivity Interruptions
U111300.repair_steps: Do NOT replace head unit hardware. 1. Update MBUX head unit A26/17 software to latest FUP release via XENTRY Diagnosis. 2. Verify customer iPhone iOS version and remove conflicting VPN profiles.

B210D13.title: MBUX Transparent Hood Feature Inoperative in Off-Road Display (FUP5 E504.3)
B210D13.repair_steps: Do NOT replace MBUX head unit or 360-degree camera hardware. Apply the FUP5 parameterization hotfix patch to control unit A26/17 via XENTRY Flash.

B1F4500.title: Traffic Light View Intermittently Inoperable After MBUX OTA Update
B1F4500.repair_steps: Do NOT replace camera or central display hardware. Update MBUX multimedia control unit A26/17 to software version E329.5 or newer via XENTRY Diagnosis.

P26E400.title: W465 G 580 EQ Technology - G-TURN Aborted Due to Inverter Thermal Model
P26E400.repair_steps: Do NOT replace quad-motor inverters or cooling pumps. Flash N127 Drivetrain Control Unit to firmware v1.18.4 via XENTRY and reset thermal adaptation counters.

B15A100.title: MBUX NTG7 'Hey Mercedes' Voice Assistant Wake-Word Freeze After Profile Switch
B15A100.repair_steps: Do NOT replace microphone array or head unit. Clear MBUX voice recognition user cache partition via XENTRY Service Routines and apply SCN coding patch.
